title: Wagmi
tagline: Usage of Formal Verification for smart contract security verification.
description: Usage of Formal Verification for smart contract security verification. The used tools were Certora Prover and Foundry Halmos runned via Deivitto/auditor-docker. Smart contracts often handle significant amounts of value and sensitive data. Any vulnerability or bug can lead to substantial financial losses or data breaches. Formal verification helps to ensure that the contract behaves as intended under all possible conditions, reducing the risk of exploits and vulnerabilities.
